scenes.headline: Software is buying from software.
scenes.vo: Software is buying from software. Data. Prices. Compute. But AI agents have no credit cards, and no time for invoices.

scenes.headline: APIs are free. Getting paid isn't.
scenes.vo: So sellers give away their APIs for free. No way to charge per request, and no way to prove the money actually arrived.

scenes.headline: TILL
scenes.vo: Till is the payment gateway for this new economy, built on NEAR.

scenes.headline: Point. Price. Paid.
scenes.vo: Point Till at any API. Set a price in digital dollars. Switch the paywall on.

scenes.headline: 402 Payment Required
scenes.vo: Now every request has a price. When an agent asks without paying, Till answers with a four oh two: payment required.

scenes.headline: Verified. Served. Settled.
scenes.vo: The agent signs one gasless payment. Till verifies it, serves the data, and settles on NEAR.

scenes.headline: Real settlement. NEAR testnet.
scenes.vo: This is a real transaction on NEAR testnet. Not a mock-up. Every paid request leaves a receipt anyone can check.

scenes.headline: One payment in. One payout out.
scenes.vo: Payouts are built on NEAR Intents, so sellers choose the stablecoin and the chain they get paid on. And every payment is matched to its payout by transaction hash.

scenes.headline: When money disagrees, Till finds it.
scenes.vo: If a payout is refunded, Till explains what happened in plain English, and tells the seller what to do next.

scenes.headline: Blocked at the gate.
scenes.vo: Agents that take data without settling get blocked at the gate, before they burn a cent of gas.

scenes.headline: Charge agents by the request. Prove every payout.
scenes.vo: Till. Charge agents by the request. Prove every payout. Real World Money and Agent Economy, at NEAR Hackathon twenty twenty six.
